tickets.problem: M7162 and M7160 z-axis not at tool position and x-axis not at tool position

report.pr:
M7162 and M7160 z-axis not at tool position and x-axis not at tool position
(Machine not stop in auto cycle after occurred this alarm) Turret not clamp
report.ca:
Our service team observed the issue and investigated why the alarm was generated.
During the investigation, it was found that the turret moved to the cutting position without being clamped because the required interlock was not available in the PLC program.
To prevent this issue in the future, the team added a small PLC program (interlock). Now, if the turret is not clamped properly, it will stop at the same position and will not move forward to the cutting position.
After implementing this change, a program trial was conducted successfully. The operator also ran a program and confirmed that the machine was working properly.
Currently, the machine is kept under observation.
They also informed us that their engineer will visit the site to check the PLC ladder program and verify the interlocking.
This modification has been done mainly for machine safety purposes to prevent any possible accident or damage. In the future, if the turret does not clamp properly, the machine will stop at the same position instead of moving towards the cutting position.

tickets.problem: KMT service engineer and Phoenix Service engineer visited the machine to check the problem.

report.pr: KMT service engineer and Phoenix Service engineer visited the machine to check the problem.
report.ca:
The KMT service engineer visited the machine today and carried out the following work:
•	Checked the KMT pump.
•	Removed the KMT pump pipes.
•	Removed the right-side end cover and cylinder assembly.
•	Removed the Hulse Liner pipe and seal assembly.
•	Checked the proximity sensor and measured the gap between the plunger and proximity sensor. The gap was checked and found to be 40 to 60 microns.
•	Repeated the same procedure on the right side.
•	Removed all assemblies and cleaned them properly.
•	Installed a new piston and connected the right-side new plunger. The left-side plunger was also reconnected.
•	Rechecked the piston and plunger assemblies and reinstalled them in the pump.
•	Reinstalled both the right-side and left-side cartridge assemblies after that flange new connected.
•	Both sides' seal assemblies, liner pipes, HP cylinders, cylinder head assemblies, and end caps were reinstalled and connected.
•	All pipes were reconnected.
•	Hydraulic oil was drained from the tank.
•	The hydraulic oil tank was cleaned properly.
•	The oil filter was removed and replaced with a new filter.
•	Hydraulic oil was replaced with new Shell Tellus S2 M 68.
•	sealing head assembly change new one replaced 
•	All machine parameters were checked.
•	The machine was started, handover to production.

tickets.problem: S52 overload warning 00E1.00 Y S03 over load 1   0050.00 Y  Alarm

report.pr: S52 overload warning 00E1.00 Y / S03 over load 1   0050.00 Y  Alarm
report.ca:
Machine was checked, and a Y-axis overload alarm was observed. The alarm is occurring even before starting the job cutting operation. The Y-axis machine load is also going above 120%.

We informed our service team about the issue. They asked us to check the brake cable from the top side, and it was found OK.
